changelog:
v3.7.10 — Series & Movies That Used to Black-Screen Now Play

If you've ever started a series episode or movie and seen the screen go black after a few seconds while audio kept playing — followed eventually by "This content uses a video format not supported on this device" — that's fixed.

What was happening: on some Fire TV Stick Lite / older Fire TV Stick hardware, the built-in video decoder would render one frame and then quietly stall. The app would try a couple of fallbacks, but they were the same single-threaded decoder under the hood, so it'd fail again and give up.

What's new: the app now falls back to a multi-threaded software video decoder (the same one IPTV Smarters and TiviMate use under the hood) — content that used to give up now keeps playing.

• Verified against the customer report on Fire TV Stick Lite (AFTSS) where Beyond the Gates and similar series episodes were silently failing
• No change for devices that were already working — the new path only activates when the normal decoders can't keep up
• If a stream really can't be played on your hardware, you'll still see a friendly error — but only after we've actually exhausted every option
